name: 건강/의료 상담
description: 소아 야간상담, 정신건강 상담, 금연·절주 상담, 심야약국 찾기 등 급할 때 찾는 건강 상담 서비스

en.name: Health & Medical Consultation
en.description: Health consultation services for urgent needs — pediatric night consultation, mental health counseling, smoking/drinking cessation counseling, and finding late-night pharmacies.

name: 교통/자동차
description: 자동차 등록·이력 조회, 사고 과실비율 확인, 결함 리콜 신고 등 자동차 생활에 필요한 정보 서비스

en.name: Transportation & Vehicles
en.description: Information services for everyday vehicle needs — checking vehicle registration and history, confirming accident fault ratios, and reporting defect recalls.

name: 긴급상황
description: 재난안전상담, 정신건강 위기상담, 자살예방상담(1393) 등 긴급 상황 대응 서비스

en.name: Emergencies
en.description: Emergency response services — disaster and safety consultation, mental health crisis counseling, and suicide prevention counseling (1393).

name: 반려동물
description: 동물등록 조회, 동물병원 진료비 비교, 취약계층 진료비 지원 등 반려동물과 함께하는 생활에 필요한 서비스

en.name: Pets
en.description: Services for life with a pet — checking animal registration, comparing veterinary treatment costs, and treatment cost support for low-income households.

name: 법률/행정
description: 무료 법률구조공단, 임대차분쟁조정위, 노동상담(고용노동부) 등 법률·행정 관련 상담 서비스

en.name: Legal & Administrative
en.description: Legal and administrative consultation services — the free Korea Legal Aid Corporation, the Housing Lease Dispute Mediation Committee, and labor consultation from the Ministry of Employment and Labor.

name: 보험
description: 보험 비교, 실손보험금 청구, 숨은 보험금 찾기, 보험사기 신고 등 내 보험을 제대로 챙기는 데 필요한 서비스

en.name: Insurance
en.description: Services for managing your insurance properly — comparing insurance products, filing indemnity insurance claims, finding unclaimed insurance money, and reporting insurance fraud.

name: 생활행정 팁
description: 정부24 활용법, 무료 심리검사, 무료 온라인 교육 등 알아두면 유용한 생활 행정 정보

en.name: Everyday Admin Tips
en.description: Useful everyday administrative information — how to use Gov24, free psychological tests, and free online courses.

name: 세금/금융
description: 연말정산 간소화, 채무조정 상담, 휴면예금 조회 등 세금과 금융 생활에 필요한 상담·조회 서비스

en.name: Tax & Finance
en.description: Consultation and lookup services for taxes and finances — simplified year-end tax settlement, debt restructuring consultation, and checking dormant bank deposits.

name: 소비자보호
description: 1372 소비자상담센터, 전자상거래 분쟁조정 등 소비자 피해 구제 서비스

en.name: Consumer Protection
en.description: Consumer damage relief services — the 1372 Consumer Counseling Center and e-commerce dispute mediation.

name: 어르신/노인복지
description: 노인장기요양보험, 치매안심센터, 노인맞춤돌봄서비스 등 어르신의 건강하고 안전한 생활을 지원하는 복지 서비스

en.name: Senior Welfare
en.description: Welfare services that support a healthy, safe life for older adults — long-term care insurance for the elderly, Dementia Relief Centers, and personalized senior care services.

name: 육아/가족
description: 아이돌봄서비스, 청소년상담 1388, 실종아동 찾기(안전Dream) 등 육아·가족 지원 서비스

en.name: Childcare & Family
en.description: Childcare and family support services — the Idolbom childcare service, youth counseling at 1388, and finding missing children (Safe Dream).

name: 주거/부동산
description: 청약홈, 전세보증금 반환보증, 등기부등본 발급, 실거래가 조회 등 내 집 마련과 임대차 생활에 필요한 부동산 행정 서비스

en.name: Housing & Real Estate
en.description: Real-estate administrative services for buying a home and renting — the Cheongyak Home subscription system, jeonse deposit return guarantees, issuing property registers, and checking actual transaction prices.

name: 취업/창업
description: K-Startup, 소상공인 정책자금, 신용보증재단 등 취업과 창업을 준비하는 사람을 위한 지원 서비스

en.name: Employment & Startups
en.description: Support services for people preparing for employment or starting a business — K-Startup, policy funding for small business owners, and Credit Guarantee Foundations.

name: 환경/에너지
description: 무공해차 보조금, 에너지바우처, 탄소중립포인트 등 환경·에너지 생활에 필요한 지원 서비스

en.name: Environment & Energy
en.description: Support services for environmental and energy needs — zero-emission vehicle subsidies, energy vouchers, and the Carbon Neutral Point program.

name: 교육/평생학습
description: 국비 직업훈련, 학점은행제, K-MOOC 등 평생학습과 온라인 강좌 정보를 제공하는 서비스

en.name: Education & Lifelong Learning
en.description: Services providing lifelong-learning and online course information — government-funded vocational training, the Academic Credit Bank System, and K-MOOC.

name: 장애인/복지
description: 장애인 고용, 보조기기 교부, 재활 정보 등 장애인의 생활을 지원하는 서비스

en.name: Disability Welfare
en.description: Services that support daily life for people with disabilities — employment for people with disabilities, assistive device distribution, and rehabilitation information.

name: 문화/여가
description: 문화누리카드, 스포츠강좌이용권, 국내여행 정보 등 문화·여가 생활을 지원하는 공공 서비스

en.name: Culture & Leisure
en.description: Public services supporting cultural and leisure activities — the Culture Card, the Sports Class Voucher, and domestic travel information.

name: 안전점검
description: 승강기·놀이시설·가스·전기 등 생활 안전점검·안전정보를 제공하는 서비스

en.name: Safety Checks
en.description: Services providing everyday safety inspections and information — elevators, playground equipment, gas, and electricity.
